def factor_price_volume_ewm_confirmation(df):
    """Exponentially weighted price-volume demand confirmation via rolling correlation of price and volume changes."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close_ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    volume_safe = df_copy["volume"].replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_ret = volume_safe.pct_change()
    cov = close_ret.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).cov(vol_ret)
    var_close = close_ret.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).var()
    var_vol = vol_ret.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).var()
    denom = (np.sqrt(var_close * var_vol)).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    corr = cov / denom
    corr = corr.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    df_copy["factor_price_volume_ewm_confirmation"] = corr
    return df_copy["factor_price_volume_ewm_confirmation"]
description: Mutation preserves the parent's core price-volume demand-confirmation mechanism: positive rolling correlation between price returns and volume changes indicates synchronized demand pressure that persists after industry and size neutralization. The change replaces equal-weight rolling correlation with exponentially weighted correlation (span=20), which emphasizes recent observations while retaining a single clear economic mechanism. This smoothing aims to improve responsiveness and top-quantile payoff without adding a new feature family.
